question: Which state hosted the National Yoga Day Ceremony on 21 June 2025 with Prime Minister Narendra Modi as the chief guest?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Andhra Pradesh**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **11th International Day of Yoga (IDY)** ceremony, held on **June 21, 2025**, was hosted by the state of **Andhra Pradesh**.
 
• Prime Minister **Narendra Modi** graced the occasion as the **Chief Guest**, leading the mass yoga demonstration along with thousands of participants. ***Hence, the statement regarding Andhra Pradesh as the host is correct.***
 
• The event highlighted the **cultural heritage** and **spiritual significance** of the region, specifically focusing on the integration of **yoga** into daily life for holistic well-being.
 
• The selection of **Andhra Pradesh** as the national venue underscores the government's initiative to decentralize major national celebrations across different states of **India**.
 
• The **Ministry of Ayush** worked in coordination with the **State Government of Andhra Pradesh** to organize this large-scale event, ensuring participation from various **educational institutions**, **NGOs**, and **yoga enthusiasts**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Origin of International Day of Yoga:**
 
 
• The idea for an **International Day of Yoga** was first proposed by Prime Minister **Narendra Modi** during his address to the **United Nations General Assembly (UNGA)** on **September 27, 2014**.
 
• The **UNGA** draft resolution was passed with a record **175 member states** co-sponsoring the initiative, leading to the official declaration of **June 21** as the **International Day of Yoga**.
 
 
 
• **Ministry of Ayush:**
 
 
• This **Union Ministry** is the nodal agency for the celebration of **Yoga Day** in **India**.
 
• It promotes **Ayurveda, Yoga, Naturopathy, Unani, Siddha, and Homoeopathy**. The ministry issues the **Common Yoga Protocol (CYP)**, which serves as a guide for yoga performances globally.
 
 
 
• **Global Participation:**
 
 
• The **International Day of Yoga** is observed in nearly **190 countries**, with major events organized at iconic locations like **Times Square** in **New York** and the **Eiffel Tower** in **Paris**.
 
• It aims to raise **global awareness** about the numerous benefits of practicing yoga, which is an **ancient Indian physical, mental, and spiritual practice**.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• **Symbolism of June 21:**
 
 
• The date **June 21** was chosen because it is the **Summer Solstice**, the **longest day of the year** in the **Northern Hemisphere**.
 
• In **Indian mythology**, the **Summer Solstice** marks the transition to **Dakshinayana** and is considered the period when **Lord Shiva** (the **Adiyogi**) began imparting the knowledge of yoga to the **Saptarishis**.
 
 
 
• **Previous Host Cities:**
 
 
• The first-ever **Yoga Day** in **2015** was held at **Rajpath, New Delhi**, creating two **Guinness World Records**.
 
• In subsequent years, the national event moved to cities like **Chandigarh (2016)**, **Lucknow (2017)**, **Dehradun (2018)**, **Ranchi (2019)**, **Mysuru (2022)**, **Jabalpur (2023)**, and **Srinagar (2024)**.
 
 
 
• **Yoga for Health:**
 
 
• Scientific studies promoted during these events highlight that **Yoga** helps in reducing **stress**, improving **cardiovascular health**, and enhancing **mental clarity**.
 
• The **World Health Organization (WHO)** also mentions **Yoga** as a tool to improve physical activity in its **Global Action Plan 2018-2030**.
